interval_years.quote: a license to practice podiatric medicine expires on a date established by the agency under IC 25-1-5-4 in each odd-numbered year.

required.quote: Except for a showing of good cause that is acceptable to the board, evidence of the podiatrist's maintenance of professional medical competence, which may include continuing podiatric medical education, postgraduate studies, institutes, seminars, lectures, conferences, work shops, professional evaluation, and specialty board certification or recertification during the preceding four (4) years.

period_years.quote: specialty board certification or recertification during the preceding four (4) years.

available.quote: The board may issue a license to an applicant who pays a fee established by the board and who presents satisfactory evidence to the board that the applicant: (1) meets the requirements under IC 25-29-3-1; (2) is licensed in a state, territory, or possession of the United States;

requirements.value: Must meet standard licensure requirements, be licensed in another US state/territory/possession, have passed a substantially equivalent podiatric medical licensing examination, and have practiced podiatric medicine for at least five years.
requirements.quote: has passed a podiatric medical licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination approved by the board; and (4) has practiced podiatric medicine for at least five (5) years.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently
disciplinary_grounds.quote: does not have a conviction for a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject of disciplinary action by a licensing or certification agency of another state on grounds of inability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has not been the subject of a disciplinary action by a licensing or certification agency of another state or jurisdiction on the grounds that the applicant was not able to practice podiatric medicine without endangering the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting or authorizing a person to fill or refill a prescription or drug order for a legend drug except as authorized by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A podiatrist licensed in Indiana who permits or authorizes a person to fill or refill a prescription or drug order for a legend drug except as authorized in IC 16-42-19 is subject to disciplinary action under IC 25-1-9.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental illness, physical illness, or excessive use or habitual abuse of a controlled substance or alcohol impairing ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board determines that a podiatrist is impaired from practicing podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of a mental illness, a physical illness, or an excessive use or habitual abuse of a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Voluntary surrender or voluntary limitation on a license or authorization to practice in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The podiatrist's voluntary surrender or voluntary limitation on a license or authorization to practice podiatric medicine in another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial to issue a license or authorization to practice medicine in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any denial to issue the podiatrist a license or authorization to practice medicine in another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Voluntary resignation from or limitation of staff privileges at a health care institution while under investigation for medical incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The podiatrist's voluntary resignation from the medical staff of a health care institution or voluntary limitation of the podiatrist's staff privileges at the health care institution if the action occurred while the podiatrist was under investigation by the health care institution for possible medical incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or a mental or physical impairment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Voluntary resignation from a podiatric medical society while under investigation for medical incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The podiatrist's voluntary resignation or withdrawal from a podiatric medical society, an association, or an organization if the action occurred while the podiatrist was under investigation or review by the medical body for possible medical incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or a mental or physical impairment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction or treatment for addiction to alcohol or a chemical substance during the preceding two years
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any addiction or treatment for addiction to alcohol or a chemical substance during the preceding two (2) years.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical injury, disease, or mental illness during the preceding two years that affected or may affect ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any physical injury or disease or mental illness during the preceding two (2) years that affected or may affect the podiatrist's ability to practice podiatric medicine.

definition_quote.value: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures. (b) Podiatric medicine includes the administration of local anesthetics.

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may administer local anesthetics and may prescribe legend drugs; permitting unauthorized persons to fill prescriptions is grounds for discipline.
drug_authority.quote: Podiatric medicine includes the administration of local anesthetics.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures.

amputation_authorized.quote: The term does not include the amputation of the entire foot, but does include the amputation of an entire toe if the amputation is performed at an institution: (1) that is approved by a joint commission of accredited hospital organizations; and (2) where comanagement of the patient is being performed by a physician licensed under IC 25-22.5.

anesthesia_authority.quote: Podiatric medicine includes the administration of local anesthetics.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures.

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: An employee of a podiatrist or group of podiatrists who performs an act, a duty, or a function that is customarily within the specific area of practice of the employing podiatrist or group of podiatrists, if the act, duty, or function is performed under the direction and supervision of the employing podiatrist

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: if the act, duty, or function is performed under the direction and supervision of the employing podiatrist or a podiatrist of the employing group within whose area of practice the act, duty, or function falls.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The board may adopt rules that do the following: (1) Require podiatrists to report an impaired podiatrist to the board. (2) Approve certain voluntary treatment programs for impaired podiatrists that are medically directed and nonprofit.
